notes.title: Update 1.4
notes.content:
Hello War Landers,

This update brings a long awaited local high score tracking. It also improves the rendering engine and makes the AI more dynamic.

+ added score tracking and high score screen
+ added additional resolutions
+ improved rendering engine to hit a solid 60 FPS and not stutter
+ fixed some bugs related to text overlaps and different screen sizes

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
Howdy folks,
Update 1.2 is now live and adds some features and bug fixes:

+ Fixed that certain conditions let small forces win against much bigger armies. - Thanks to Stefanator for reporting this.
+ Fixed that armies could be transported from game to game. - Thanks to Stefanator for reporting this one too!
+ Added statistics to the end game screen.
+ Made the resolution selection less terrible, now smaller resolutions just let you pan the map.
+ Added a much needed tutorial when first starting the game.

Enjoy!

- Phantom
